paper_title: Axion-Like Particles and Recent Observations of the Cosmic Infrared Background Radiation
notes: This paper proposes ALP-photon conversion to resolve the tension between TeV gamma-ray spectra of distant blazars (H2356-309, 1ES1101-232) and the CIBER cosmic IR background. Fig. 5 shows CONTOURS OF THE ALLOWED (preferred/favored) REGION in the (m_a, g_aγ) plane at 95% CL from chi^2 fitting (m_a ~ 7e-10 to 5e-8 eV, 1.5e-11 to 8.8e-10 GeV^-1) where the tension is solved -- this is a preferred region, NOT an exclusion of a coupling region. The only exclusion line in Fig. 5 (g_aγ < 8.8e-11 GeV^-1, CAST) is imported from ref [27] (CAST Collaboration), not derived by this paper. The paper derives no new experimental/observational exclusion bound of its own, so is_new_limit=false. It is also not a sensitivity forecast for a proposed experiment (is_projection=false).
